translated_title: Mexico Has Paid 1.6 Trillion Pesos on the Fobaproa Bank Bailout, yet the Debt Keeps Growing: “A Scam,” Says the Finance Ministry
original_title: México ya pagó 1.6 billones de Fobaproa. La deuda sigue creciendo. “Una estafa”: SHCP
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
meta_description: Mexico has paid nearly 1.6 trillion pesos on the Fobaproa bank bailout, yet not one peso of the principal — the debt keeps growing. The 2027 budget earmarks 48 billion pesos more.
